data.one_liner: A Flutter plugin for detecting mock locations on Android devices.
data.what_it_does: Trust Location allows developers to query current geographic coordinates and detect whether an Android device is using a mock location. It supports both one-time queries and periodic streams.
use_when: You need to prevent GPS spoofing or fake locations in your Android app.
You want to monitor user location changes alongside mock location detection using a timer stream.
avoid_when: You need robust iOS mock location detection (this plugin explicitly supports Android).
You do not require high accuracy location mode.
strengths: Provides a simple boolean flag to check for mock locations.
Supports stream-based location updates with configurable timer intervals.
weaknesses: Requires high accuracy location mode to be enabled in Android settings.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION or ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION permissions to the Android Manifest and enabling high accuracy mode.

alternatives.name: geolocator
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick geolocator if you need a comprehensive, cross-platform geolocation plugin that also provides mock location detection on Android.
